## Prospective PhD students 

**What I am open to supervising.** Highly ambitious projects in international and european political economy; global health governance; global social protection; and the political economy of the green transition. I am very open in terms of methodological approaches (my work relies on both quantitative and qualitative methods), provided they are appropriate to answer the research questions being investigated.

**How to get in touch.** As I am the director of the [Bocconi PhD in Social and Political Sciences](https://www.unibocconi.eu/en/programs/phd/phd-social-and-political-science), I sit on the admissions committee and therefore cannot offer detailed advice or guidance on your research ideas. So, as long as your interests align with mine, you can assume that I am in principle available to supervise. Confirmation by a supervisor that they are interested in working with you is *not* necessary at the application stage. Bocconi has many [leading academics](https://sps.unibocconi.eu/people) who are available to supervise PhD students, so you should take a close look at whose work might be the best fit with your research interests. Any questions about the Bocconi SPS PhD program should be directed to [phd.sps@unibocconi.it](mailto:phd.sps@unibocconi.it).
